name: AI 视频专家
tagline: Turns one photograph into a short, moody film clip
description: Hand it a single image and a line of direction, and it writes out how the shot should move and what it should feel like before rendering a frame. What comes back is a brief clip with deliberate camera work rather than a drifting animation. Your approval is required before it goes anywhere public.
author: KinGao476942
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
